index.title: TARUDEREO — NGO in Kasulu, Kigoma Region, Tanzania
index.metaDescription: TARUDEREO is a registered NGO based in Kasulu, Kigoma Region, Tanzania, working on maternal health, education for vulnerable children, women's economic empowerment, and rural community development.

hero.headline: Building Dignity, Health & Opportunity in Rural Kigoma
hero.lead: TARUDEREO is a registered NGO based in Kasulu, working alongside rural communities on maternal health, education for vulnerable children, women's and youth economic empowerment, and community development.

about.headline: What is TARUDEREO?
about.body: Tanzania Rural Development and Relief Organization (TARUDEREO) is a non-governmental, nonprofit organization improving the living standards of Tanzanians through water and sanitation, community services, natural resource and environmental protection, infrastructure development, and humanitarian assistance.

story.headline: Registered Since 2002, Re-registered in 2023
story.body: Based in Mission Street, Murubona Ward, Kasulu District, Kigoma Region, TARUDEREO is registered by the Ministry of Community Development, Gender, Women and Special Groups under the NGO Act No. 24 (Certificate No. ooNGO/R/5461, issued 29 September 2023).
